FREELANCE SERVICES AGREEMENT
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DOCUMENT. Fictional parties. Not a real contract.
This Agreement is made on 1 March 2026 between Northwind Digital Ltd, a fictional company (the
"Client"), and Jordan Example, a fictional freelance designer (the "Contractor").
1. SERVICES. The Contractor will provide brand design and website design services as described
in Schedule A (the "Services"). The Client may change the scope of the Services at any time by
email, and the Contractor must complete the changed scope without additional charge.
2. TERM. This Agreement starts on 1 March 2026 and continues for an initial term of 12 months.
After the initial term it renews automatically for successive 12 month terms unless either party gives
written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the end of the then-current term.
3. FEES. The Client will pay the Contractor a fixed fee of USD 24,000 for the Services, payable in
twelve equal monthly instalments of USD 2,000. The Contractor is responsible for all of their own
taxes and expenses.

4. PAYMENT TERMS. The Contractor will invoice monthly. The Client will pay each invoice
within 75 days of receipt. If the Contractor delivers any work late, a late fee of 5% of the
monthly fee is deducted for each week of delay. The Client may withhold payment of any
invoice it disputes in good faith, without limit of time.
5. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY. All work product, including any pre-existing materials, tools,
templates and ideas the Contractor uses or mentions in connection with the Services, becomes the
sole property of the Client on creation. The Contractor assigns all rights worldwide and waives all
moral rights. The Contractor may not show the work in a portfolio without written consent.
6. CONFIDENTIALITY. The Contractor must keep all information about the Client confidential
during the term and for 10 years after the Agreement ends.
7. NON-COMPETE. During the term and for 24 months after it ends, the Contractor will not provide
design services to any business that operates in the same industry as the Client or any of its
affiliates, anywhere in the world.

8. TERMINATION. The Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason or no
reason, with 24 hours written notice. The Contractor may terminate only for the Client's
uncured material breach, with 60 days written notice. On termination by the Client, the Client
owes fees only for Services accepted before the termination date.
9. LIABILITY. The Contractor is liable for all losses, damages and costs of any kind arising from the
Services, with no cap. The Client's total liability to the Contractor will not exceed the fees paid in the
previous one month.
10. INDEMNITY. The Contractor will indemnify the Client against all claims, including claims arising
from the Client's own instructions or negligence.
11. INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR. The Contractor is an independent contractor and not an
employee. The Contractor must work the hours set by the Client and use equipment specified by
the Client.
12. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTES. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the fictional
Republic of Examplia. Disputes will be resolved by binding arbitration in Examplia City, with the
Contractor paying all arbitration costs.
SIGNED: Northwind Digital Ltd (Client) ____________ Jordan Example (Contractor)
____________

keyTerms.summary: This freelance services agreement sets out that Northwind Digital Ltd hires Jordan Example to provide brand and website design work starting on 1 March 2026 for an initial 12‑month term, with automatic yearly renewals unless 90‑day notice is given. The contractor is paid a fixed USD 24,000 in monthly installments, with payment terms, penalties, confidentiality, non‑compete, termination rights and governing law in the fictional Republic of Examplia.

flags.quote: After the initial term it renews automatically for successive 12 month terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 90 days before the end of the then-current term.
flags.title: Automatic renewal
flags.explanation: The agreement renews for another year automatically unless notice is given 90 days before the term ends, which can lock the contractor into a long commitment.

flags.quote: All work product, including any pre-existing materials, tools, templates and ideas the Contractor uses or mentions in connection with the Services, becomes the sole property of the Client on creation. The Contractor assigns all rights worldwide and waives all moral rights. The Contractor may not show the work in a portfolio without written consent.
flags.title: All IP to client
flags.explanation: All work product, including the contractor’s pre‑existing materials and ideas, becomes the client’s sole property and the contractor waives moral rights, limiting future use or portfolio display.

flags.quote: During the term and for 24 months after it ends, the Contractor will not provide design services to any business that operates in the same industry as the Client or any of its affiliates, anywhere in the world.
flags.title: Broad non‑compete
flags.explanation: The contractor is barred from providing design services to any business in the same industry worldwide for the contract term plus two years, which is unusually wide in scope and duration.

flags.quote: The Client may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason or no reason, with 24 hours written notice. The Contractor may terminate only for the Client's uncured material breach, with 60 days written notice.
flags.title: Client can quit anytime
flags.explanation: The client may terminate with only 24‑hour notice for any reason, while the contractor can only quit for material breach with 60‑day notice, creating an imbalance of power.

flags.quote: The Contractor is liable for all losses, damages and costs of any kind arising from the Services, with no cap. The Client's total liability to the Contractor will not exceed the fees paid in the previous one month.
flags.title: Uncapped contractor liability
flags.explanation: The contractor is liable for all losses with no cap, while the client’s liability is limited to one month’s fees, exposing the contractor to potentially unlimited risk.

flags.quote: The Contractor will indemnify the Client against all claims, including claims arising from the Client's own instructions or negligence.
flags.title: One‑sided indemnity
flags.explanation: The contractor must indemnify the client for all claims, even those caused by the client’s own instructions or negligence, placing all risk on the contractor.

flags.quote: The Client will pay each invoice within 75 days of receipt. If the Contractor delivers any work late, a late fee of 5% of the monthly fee is deducted for each week of delay. The Client may withhold payment of any invoice it disputes in good faith, without limit of time.
flags.title: Long payment window & penalties
flags.explanation: The client has up to 75 days to pay invoices and can withhold disputed payments indefinitely, while the contractor faces a 5% weekly deduction for late delivery, creating financial strain.

result.answer: The Client can end the agreement with 24 hours written notice, while the Contractor can only end it for the Client’s uncured material breach with 60 days written notice.
